entries.title: Selaco
entries.definitive_edition: Selaco on Windows PC, with a final-edition caveat until 1.0 leaves Early Access

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation, dependent on current Early Access build.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best current route because Selaco is sourced as a Steam Early Access PC release, the official materials describe Steam availability, and no shipped console or GOG release with exclusive content is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Selaco on Steam for Windows PC and play the current Early Access build; if you want the final campaign, wait for the 1.0 release.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC Early Access release.
all_releases.reason: primary: preferred capture/settings route and the only currently sourced storefront route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Linux PC route, with Steam system support.
all_releases.reason: skip: same Early Access content family; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/settings route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The current PC version is the best available route, but it is still an Early Access build rather than the finished 1.0 campaign.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; the important caveat is Early Access status and current Steam-only commercial availability.
